title: Detect GnRH neurons from single-cell RNA-seq data — detect_gnrh
text: Detection integrates: direct GNRH1 expression; GnRH identity specification programs; migration-associated programs; neuroendocrine maturation programs; hormonal responsiveness; alternative neuronal neuroendocrine identity programs; ambient RNA information; neighborhood enrichment using k-nearest neighbors; adaptive transcriptomic support thresholds. Classification uses two GnRH-positive routes: direct supported. routes require detectable GNRH1 expression. Cells without detected GNRH1 never classified GnRH-positive. However, cells showing strong GnRH-like transcriptomic evidence can flagged separately gnrh_dropout_candidate diagnostic purposes. Direct candidates require least min_umi raw GNRH1 counts. Supported candidates contain detectable sub-threshold GNRH1 additionally require independent GnRH identity transcriptomic support. Cells detected GNRH1 classified GnRH-positive, regardless transcriptomic support score. Strong GnRH-like GNRH1-negative cells may instead flagged gnrh_dropout_candidate exploratory diagnostic analyses. Migration-associated expression contributes supportive evidence independently establish GnRH identity. main gnrh_score includes direct GNRH1 information, whereas gnrh_support_score deliberately excludes direct GNRH1 expression ambient-RNA information.
